blocks.text: INNNEWS - The Convention Court verdict has closed the yuridis route that Denny Indrayana and the suppliers are traveling on. Gibran Rakabuming Raka remains vice president and there are no direct consequences to elections 2024.
But judging this matter as far as the amar is concerned, it's risky to ignore a much greater political dimension.
In his case, there will be no doubt about it. This fact becomes an official part of the court's consideration and is no longer just a polemic in public space.
Here lies Denny Indrayana's political victory.

From the very beginning, the arguments that the petitioners had built were not just about one document of education. The question is the policy sequence and decisions that are considered to give Gibran a special way of running for elections in 2024.

The narrative begins with the MK verdict number 90 / PUU-XXI / 2023 which adds an exception to minimum age conditions of capres- cawapres so that the head of the area selected through elections can advance even though 40 years old. It allowed Gibran who was the mayor of Surakarta to qualify for the candidacy. The verdict was then a controversy because the chairman of MK, Anwar Usman, was declared in violation of a severe conflict of interest and dismissed from the office of Chairman MK.

Therefore, for critics, the latest verdict on education's terms is not seen as a self-standing event. Instead, it was seen as part of a series of events that formed the Gibran nomination process from the very beginning.

Did those conclusions automatically prove there was any engineering or misuse of authority? No. The MK verdict doesn't say that. But the ruling provides new materials for public debates about the quality of verification, accountability of state agencies, and the integrity of electrical processes that give birth to elections 2024.

Therefore, Denny Indrayana may lose the case. But politically, he managed to achieve a greater goal: bringing a series of questions about the run-in of the Gibran region of suspicion and speculation into the region of fact that was checked in on the highest constitutional forum of the country.

The matter has been settled in the Constitution Court. But the debate about the legitimacy of the process that led to the birth of national leadership 2024 seems to be still going on in political, academic and Indonesian history.
